arStrings.szText:
The first time you damage an enemy, you contaminate them with {c_important}Aura of Lament{/c} for {c_random}[SF_0]{/c} seconds. Enemies within are Slowed by {c_number}[SF_1*100|%|]{/c} and each grant you {c_number}[SF_2]{/c} Primary Resource each second. If its host dies, {c_important}Aura of Lament{/c} transfers to a new one, retaining its duration.

You can only create an {c_important}Aura of Lament{/c} once every {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} seconds. Only {c_number}{SF_13}{/c} may exist at a time.
Purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.
You can now maintain {c_number}2{/c} {c_important}Auras of Lament{/c} at a time.
